text: {"batchcomplete":true,"query":{"pages":[{"pageid":23047220,"ns":0,"title":"Cluster-aware application","extract":"A cluster-aware application is a software application designed to call cluster APIs in order to determine its running state, in case a manual failover is triggered between cluster nodes for planned technical maintenance, or an automatic failover is required, if a computing cluster node encounters hardware or software failure, to maintain business continuity.","description":"Software application to call cluster APIs","descriptionsource":"local"}]}}
